section_summary.extract_value: This section presents an abstract for a study investigating the relationship between appearance dissatisfaction, body appreciation, and sexual health in women across adulthood. The study collected cross-sectional data online from 215 heterosexual women aged 18-88 years. It found that body appreciation uniquely predicted sexual function, satisfaction, and distress, beyond BMI and appearance dissatisfaction, and moderated the relationship between age and sexual satisfaction.
